# Deterministic scientific charts generated by AstraSentinel AI

All 15 files here are output of the real Python scientific modules in **ASTRA_OFFLINE=1** mode, tested by GitHub Actions.

Historical bundled 2024 TLE (orbit), synthetic illustrative historical Kp and seeded entirely synthetic telemetry are used. Rocket curves are computed by a simplified educational 1D numerical solver.

These graphs are **not current space mission readings, launch certification, or genuine spacecraft health telemetry**.

| Model-produced graph | Interpretation |
|---|---|
| [Orbit estimated altitude](orbit_altitude_demo.svg) | Historical SGP4 demo elements |
| [Estimated orbital latitude](orbit_latitude_demo.svg) | Approximate Earth-fixed latitude |
| [Rocket altitude](rocket_ascent_demo.svg) | 1D educational flight case |
| [Rocket vertical speed](rocket_velocity_demo.svg) | 1D numerical simulation |
| [Rocket dynamic pressure](rocket_dynamic_pressure_demo.svg) | 1D drag/loading estimate |
| [Rocket thrust sensitivity](rocket_thrust_sensitivity_demo.svg) | Deterministic one-factor parameter experiment |
| [Modeled atmospheric density](atmosphere_density_demo.svg) | Simplified exponential density model |
| [Synthetic space weather Kp](space_weather_kp_demo.svg) | Not an observed current NOAA event |
| [Synthetic telemetry temperature](telemetry_temperature_demo.svg) | Artificial satellite health values |
| [Synthetic telemetry voltage](telemetry_voltage_demo.svg) | Artificial satellite health values |

Four CSV files and the source-attributed mission JSON snapshot are provided alongside the charts.
